en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a brick arched bridge with decorative towers and balustrades crossing over a sloping road and embankments. Leafless trees suggest a winter or early spring scene. Two people stand on the bridge parapet. Printed captions at the bottom identify the location as Nijmegen and the bridge as leading to the Belvédère. Publisher and photographer credits appear in small type and there is a handwritten name at the lower right.
